title: Future Work Items
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of future-work-miner. Collects explicitly stated open problems and future-work directions extracted from paper_note artifacts. An empty items array is allowed (a clean paper may yield zero future-work statements). Every present item carries a non-empty, non-whitespace source_ref (anti-slop): an item with a missing/blank source_ref is schema-rejected.

items.description: Extracted future-work items; each present item must carry a non-blank source_ref.

statement.description: The stated open problem or future-work direction, verbatim or closely paraphrased from the source. Must contain a non-whitespace character.

source_ref.description: The [[slug]] / paper_note id / path this item was mined from (anti-slop evidence pointer). Must be non-empty AND non-whitespace (a blank pointer is not evidence).

gap_hint.description: Optional free-text hint for downstream gap classification.
